purpose: Teach: 創り/分別/持ち込ま/金庫/定量/届け出/書式/配管

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、何もないところから事業を創り上げた。
lines.en: When I was young, I built this business from nothing.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. The weight of decades in the pause. Matter-of-fact — not boasting, simply stating what was. Voice steady and low, like a stone laid down.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、分別意識、定着しています。
lines.en: Yes. The staff understood that discretion early, and it's held.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. A slight nod in the voice. Careful, attentive — showing he's listened and retained. Not rushed. The precision of someone who takes the message seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 機密、家に持ち込ませる文化、当時から、避けてきた。
lines.en: We've kept confidential work out of people's homes since then. That's always been the rule.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Matter-of-fact, no defensiveness. The tone of someone explaining a foundation that's never wavered. Slight lean forward in the delivery — this matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。金庫、創業時のもの、まだ使っています。
lines.en: Yes. We still use the safe from when we started. It's still here.
lines.style: Straightforward respect. Slight warmth — acknowledging the continuity. Not sentimental, but grounded. The voice of someone who understands why old things stay.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 定量供給、信頼の基本だ。
lines.en: Consistency in supply — that's the foundation of trust.
lines.style: Deliberate. Each word placed. The tone of distilled wisdom — not lecturing, just offering what time has taught. Brief, final.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。各種届け出、若手に経験させています。
lines.en: Yes. I have the younger staff handle the filing work themselves. They need to learn it.
lines.style: Clear-eyed practicality. A note of pride — not in showing off, but in the conviction that experience matters. Measured cadence. Slight lift at the end — this is how we do it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 業界書式、若い頃から、自分で書いた。
lines.en: I've filled out industry forms myself since I was young. Still do.
lines.style: Simple pride. No apology, no explanation needed. The directness of someone who learned by doing. Steady, unflinching. A statement, not a performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。配管も、長期投資、忘れません。
lines.en: Yes. And the infrastructure — pipework, systems — that's always been a long-term investment. We don't forget that.
lines.style: The closing statement. Unhurried, thoughtful. A gentle settling of weight. The word "forget" carries emphasis — this is not lost on him. Final, complete. The door closing on a lifetime of principle.
